WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(1.0 * spent / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS spend_ratio
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS average_spend_ratio
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT link_to_event AS event_id,
       spend_ratio,
       spend_ratio / average_spend_ratio AS relative_spend_ratio
FROM event_ratios
CROSS JOIN overall_average
ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
